facts.text: The party must bring metal from the Dwarven mine back to Warwick the smith, in exchange for the loan of his mithril chain shirt; Warwick keeps Sir Phidipaldi's lyre and the party's plate armor meanwhile.
The party must return Warwick's mithril chain shirt, on loan from him. Ingrid says it was his grandfather's armor and he never let even her touch it.
Wayman wears Warwick's mithril chain shirt over his leather armor, on loan; it greatly improves his protection and halves damage from magic weapons and spells.

A cave-in seals the post-and-lintel entrance of the Dwarven mine, blocking the party from getting Warwick's metal. It looks natural and can be dug through; Dunk has begun shoulder-charging it open, uncovering a dead dwarf.
Warwick holds the party's plate armor (claimed by Sir Phidipaldi to be Sir Brandon's original) as collateral, presumably reclaimable when the deal is completed.
facts.uncertain_reason: Play never stated when or how the plate armor is returned; it was first offered in trade for the mithril shirt.
